title: Duplication Safety Orchestrator for Metered Shadow Tunnels
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build an orchestrator service that enables safe, metered duplication of production requests into isolated "shadow tunnels" for new model variants and tooling. The orchestrator must provide tenant-aware sampling, hard and soft cost fences, transparent billing tags for cost attribution, automated quarantine when anomalies are detected, and a low-latency, non-blocking pass-through so production latency is unaffected. This ticket covers the orchestration layer (policy engine + runtime hooks), the control-plane UI knobs (sampling rate, budget, quarantine thresholds), and integration points for telemetry and auto-rollback hooks used by canary/A-B tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can duplicate requests for a given route with probabilistic sampling configurable per-tenant and per-route
Per-tenant monthly shadow budget is enforced: duplication stops or throttles when budget is exhausted and operators are alerted
Shadow path annotated with billable tags so cost metrics appear in billing dashboards and cost attribution correlates to tenants and model variants
Quarantine mode automatically pauses duplication for a tenant when shadowed responses breach configured quality/regression thresholds
Duplication flow is fully non-blocking: production p50/p99 latency regressions < 1% relative to baseline in +50k RPS synthetic load
Operator console exposes live duplication rates, projected monthly cost, and recent anomaly events with links to failing traces
implementation_notes: Architecture: lightweight policy service + in-proxy runtime hook. Runtime hooks should be pluggable for envoy sidecar and gateway integrations
Sampling: use time-decayed reservoir sampling with per-tenant weight so small tenants still get representative coverage without blowing budgets
Budgeting: implement hard budget cap and soft alert threshold (e.g., 80% of budget). Persist budgets in config-store and expose control-plane overrides
Isolation: shadow traffic must route to tenant-scoped shadow pools (logical tenancy). Shadow pools run with a separate request quota and must be able to be paused per-tenant
Cost tagging: inject X-Redwood-Shadow-Tenant and X-Redwood-Shadow-Variant headers for billing collectors. Ensure tags are propagated through mirrors and logged in trace spans
Idempotency and dedup: make duplication idempotent by assigning a dedup-key header for replayed requests to avoid double side-effects in instrumented backends
Telemetry: emit metrics for duplicates_sent, duplicates_dropped_by_budget, duplicate_error_rate, duplicate_p99_latency_delta, and cost_estimate_per_minute
Security: shadow payloads must adhere to the same redaction/masking rules. Sensitive fields must be scrubbed or encrypted before duplication when tenant policy requires it
Rollback hooks: expose an HTTP webhook + internal event bus topic that Auto-Rollback and Canary services can subscribe to for quick disable if regressions detected
testing_plan: Unit tests for sampling logic, budget enforcement, and header propagation
Integration test with envoy sidecar and gateway in staging to validate non-blocking behavior and correct header propagation
Load test: run 50k RPS baseline + 10% duplication rate and assert production latency regression < 1% and duplicate path p95/p99 within expected bounds
Chaos test: simulate shadow pool outages and ensure production requests are not impacted and retries/backpressure on duplicates are handled gracefully
Cost simulation: synthetic tenants with varying traffic and sample rates to validate budget burn and billing tag accuracy
E2E canary: start with internal tenant only, validate metrics/alerts, then expand to small external cohort
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - internal: enable duplication for internal orgs only (engineering + infra) at 5% sample for 72h
Phase 1 - pilot customers: pick 3 low-risk customers, increase to 10% for 7 days with strict cost caps
Phase 2 - cohort expansion: enable for 10% of small customers with automatic budget enforcement and heuristic quarantine
Phase 3 - general availability: expose duplication controls in Console with per-route/tenant defaults
Automated rollback: ties into rollout service. Triggers: p99 latency delta > 50ms AND duplicate_error_rate delta > 0.5% over 5m window OR projected monthly shadow cost > budget_multiplier (1.5x)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental data leakage through shadow paths. Mitigation: enforce same-data-class redaction rules, optional payload encryption for shadow endpoints
Risk: runaway cost from high-volume tenants. Mitigation: hard budget caps, immediate throttle-to-zero when cap hit, and billing alerts
Risk: production performance regression in proxy layer. Mitigation: non-blocking async duplication, backpressure-aware queueing with bounded buffers
Risk: backend side-effects if shadowed requests are not idempotent. Mitigation: dedup-key header and opt-in guardrails for side-effecting routes
Risk: observability gaps. Mitigation: require shadow metrics emission as part of CI gating and add dashboard templates to Console
